title: One Soldier Captured 132 Enemy Troops Using Hunting Skills
description:
Corporal Alvin York single-handedly took out a German machine gun position and captured 132 soldiers in WWI, using marksmanship skills from hunting turkey in Tennessee.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
